# /etc/systemd/system/trap-sync.service
[Unit]
Description=Push Dashboard Rabbit Hole configuration to Honeypot
After=trap-lab-network.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/trap-scenario-sync

# /etc/systemd/system/trap-sync.timer
[Unit]
Description=Synchronize Rabbit Hole scenarios
[Timer]
OnBootSec=20s
OnUnitInactiveSec=10s
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
task_tmp=$(mktemp -d /var/lib/trap/log-sync/sync.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$task_tmp"' EXIT
ssh -i /var/lib/trap/log-sync/key -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/var/lib/trap/log-sync/known_hosts cowrie@10.10.10.2 > "$task_tmp/logs.tar.gz"
tar -xzf "$task_tmp/logs.tar.gz" -C "$task_tmp"
for name in cowrie.json rabbit-hole-web.jsonl; do install -o trap-dashboard -g trap-dashboard -m 0640 "$task_tmp/$name" /var/log/trap/honeypot/"$name"; done
date -Is > /var/lib/trap/log-sync/last-success
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
SSH='ssh -i /etc/trap/round5_sync_key -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new'
rsync -t --no-perms -e "$SSH" /var/lib/trap/rabbit-hole.json trapsync@10.10.10.2:/var/lib/trap/rabbit-hole.json
rsync -rt --omit-dir-times --delete --no-perms --exclude .backups -e "$SSH" /var/lib/trap/rabbit-hole-scenarios/ trapsync@10.10.10.2:/var/lib/trap/rabbit-hole-scenarios/
